.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f6dc-66d5-76e3-8faf-f9c6287c83b3.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses **banker's rounding** (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). The decision was made with the finance team in March 2026, and the notes say not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This comes from a stored project memory. I searched the code for rounding calls (`ROUND_`, `quantize`, `round(`) and found nothing, so I couldn't confirm that any code actually applies this mode.
